description: S478 Option A: a choice `@flag ? [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] : [1]` into `int[1..=2, append]` — one branch a literal outside the length bound, one inside — is refused: E-WRITE-INVARIANT at compile time, at the outside branch.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 (Option A) ("ANY branch whose literal provably breaks a tape's bound is a compile error (E-WRITE-INVARIANT)")
rationale: §66.12.2 (S478): "ANY branch whose value provably has a length outside the bound … makes the write `E-WRITE-INVARIANT`, reported at that branch, whether or not the other branches fit". The true branch is a literal of length 5 and the bound is 1..=2.
